messages:
katie (auditor): Hi team — thanks for the initial evidence packet. A couple of follow-ups from the SOC 2 review: we need the exact sampling methodology you used for keystore access logs (how slices were picked), and a concise repro/playbook for the auth incident on 2025-11-03 that caused repeated API 503s for customer 'AcmeCorp'.

ian (support): Hey @katie — we can provide both. Quick clarifiers: do you want raw log slices or processed CSVs with fields (timestamp, principal, keyId, action, requestId)? Also confirm time window: you mentioned Nov 3rd, do you want UTC or PST?

katie (auditor): Raw slices + a CSV is ideal. Use UTC for timestamps. Also please include the KMS key IDs involved and any HSM rotation events around that timeframe, plus the chain-of-custody notes for the exported logs.

raj (security): tagging in. Summary of our sampling methodology: we used stratified sampling across the three primary keystore services (keystore-api, keystore-ingest, keystore-rotator) and across spike vs baseline periods. Sampling fraction: 1% baseline, 10% during spike windows. Spike windows were defined as periods where API error-rate > 2x rolling 5m baseline. We can attach the selection script and the exact S3 prefixes we pulled.

maria (eng): putting the repro/playbook here — steps to reproduce the 503 pattern we observed (safe to run in staging):

```
# repro-playbook (staging)
# 1) seed staging with 10k keys for customer AcmeCorp
curl -X POST https://staging-internal.keystore/keys/batch -d '@acme-keys.json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_ADMIN'

# 2) run heavy concurrent create+rotate workload
for i in {1..200}; do
  seq 1 50 | xargs -P25 -I{} curl -s -X POST "https://staging-internal.keystore/keys/rotate?key=acme-${i}" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_ADMIN' &
done

# 3) induce network jitter on keystore-ingest for 45s (tc/netem)\n# optional: throttle downstream HSM RPCs to simulate backend latency
sudo tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay 200ms 10ms distribution normal
sleep 45
sudo tc qdisc del dev eth0 root netem
```

maria (eng): Observed outcome: transient bursts of 503s from keystore-api, followed by increased retries from clients that amplified load. Root cause in prod was concurrent HSM RPC backpressure + a small selector bug in the ingest worker that delayed connection reuse.

ian (support): Export links — raw log slices (gz) and CSVs uploaded to the auditor bucket with restricted ACLs: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-auditor-uploads?prefix=keystore/2112345678-acme-repro/

evidence-bot: Upload completed by ian (support) — 5 objects, total 1.2GB, md5 checksums in manifest.json.

raj (security): KMS/HSM notes: no key material rotations during the 2025-11-01 to 2025-11-05 window. The last HSM firmware update was 2025-09-12. Key IDs referenced in logs: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01-2345 and arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/zzzz-yy99-1111. Chain-of-custody manifest is included in the S3 path above (coc_manifest.md).

katie (auditor): Thanks — can you also confirm retention policy applied to these logs (where they live, retention duration, and any purging that might have occurred)? And estimate when we can expect a signed evidence packet for SOC 2 (PDF + manifest + reproduction notes)?

raj (security): Retention: access logs retained in S3 for 3 years by default (bucket lifecycle rule). Keystore debug logs are on hot storage 90d then cold archive (Glacier) after 90d. No purging occurred for the Nov 2025 window. Target for signed evidence packet: 3 business days — we'll finalize manifest and signatures and upload to the auditor bucket by 2112480000 (approx).

ian (support): Quick practical note for auditor: to replay API requests we included a playback harness (safe mode: no HSM RPCs) — see playbooks/playback/README in S3. If you want the HSM-backed full replay, we can coordinate a supervised run in our lab (requires NDA + HSM access).

katie (auditor): That looks good. One last ask: include the exact grep/awk commands or the selection SQL used to create the CSV (so auditors can validate sampling). If you already uploaded the script, point me to it.

maria (eng): uploaded selection script at the same prefix: keystore/2112345678-acme-repro/scripts/sample_selector.sh — it contains the stratified selection logic and the spike detection thresholds (literal numbers used). Link is in the manifest.

katie (auditor): Great — thanks everyone. I'll review the artifacts and open another thread if we need more. :thumbsup:"
